LanguageData.MR_SC_AVS.description: The AVS system, introduced by CP in 2013, is the full name "ADAPTIVE VEST SYSTEM", a revolutionary system that can quickly convert from low-visibility gear to a fully armed load-bearing vest through various attachments. Different accessories can be selected based on mission requirements, making it a modular tactical vest.
